info.title: Your Nightly Hearing Aid Routine
info.subtitle: A two-minute habit that keeps aids drier and clearer

rows.title: Take them out
rows.desc: Give your ears a nightly break from wear

rows.title: Wipe and brush
rows.desc: Clear wax and sweat from ports and shell

rows.title: Dry overnight
rows.desc: A drying kit pulls out trapped moisture

rows.title: Open the battery door
rows.desc: Saves power and lets condensation escape

rows.title: Check morning sound
rows.desc: Muffled after drying means time for repair
